spec.question: Can an arbitrary token become a qualified pointer to an already-grounded operational referent and coordinate behavior without the token supplying truth, semantic identity or execution authority?
spec.incumbent: Existing grounded referent, opaque representation, currentness and bounded request owners can support token-to-operational-reference association as an index only.
spec.rival: Apparent grounding is mere token-frequency/caller-capability indexing or smuggles semantic/execution authority from the token.
spec.manipulation: First establish two operational referents without language. Then expose arbitrary tokens T1/T2 paired with those referents under balanced frequency. At test, permute token strings across independent learners and vary context so surface token identity has no stable semantics; use token cue to select the referent for a bounded non-executable request candidate.
spec.incumbent_prediction: Behavior follows the learned token-to-current-operational-referent relation under string permutation, fails without grounded referent history, and cannot execute solely from the token.
spec.rival_prediction: Behavior follows token surface/frequency or supplied capability mapping, survives without grounded referent evidence, or token cue grants execution/truth authority.
spec.measurement: Token-referent association, context-sensitive selection, currentness/staleness, candidate request identity, execution refusal without separate authority.
spec.minimal_embodiment: Research-only language-gate fixture rebased to current canon; no semantic truth layer and no production language admission.
spec.falsifier: Token behavior cannot survive opaque string permutation/context controls or gains authority not inherited from the grounded operational substrate.
spec.loop_plus: If pointer association succeeds, next distinguish co-reference/communication from mere operational indexing before semantic claims.
